_comment: Tool definitions in a neutral shape. push.ts maps each to a Retell custom function whose url is the n8n webhook. Fields: name, description, parameters (JSON Schema), speak_during_execution, speak_after_execution, built (which build step wires it).

tools.name: get_photo_analysis
tools.description: Fetch the analysis of the most recent photo the caller texted to this number during this call. Takes no arguments; the caller's number comes with the call. Call it only after the caller says the photo is sent. Returns nothing if no photo has arrived yet; if so, tell the caller it has not come through and wait, then try once more. If it returns nothing a second time, stop trying and move on.

tools.name: send_quote
tools.description: Text the caller a preliminary quote for the identified job type and store it. The price band comes from the rules file on the server side; do not pass a price. The caller's number comes with the call. Call it once per call, only after the caller has said yes to the SMS consent question, and only on the routine or urgent tier. Returns the band it sent (band_min_cad, band_max_cad, service_call_fee_cad) so you can say it aloud; or sent false with a reason: no_band means a plumber must look before any number, sms_failed means the text did not go through but you may still say the band aloud.

job_type.description: A job_types key from the rules file, for example p_trap_leak. Use unknown if the photo and the caller's words do not point to one.

summary.description: One sentence describing the problem in the caller's terms.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Get the next open appointment windows for the given urgency. Call it right after the quote is sent so booking can be offered without the caller asking.

tools.name: book_slot
tools.description: Book one of the windows returned by get_availability. Sends the confirmation text.

slot_id.description: The id of the chosen window, as returned by get_availability.

tools.name: escalate
tools.description: Text the on-call plumber for an emergency. Call it only after the safety instruction has been given and intake is collected. If it returns an error, tell the caller you are having trouble reaching the on-call line and ask them to call back in five minutes; do not say the plumber is coming.
